summary: Phase 149O.19.1 -- HATP Mandatory Activation Independent-Verification Certification Architecture: architecture/trust-root design phase only (no src/pcae/** file, contract file, or protected-root state was created or modified). Confirmed baseline via direct inspection: repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.19 completed/complete at 37a2066f/pushed, verdict VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS, activation-certification verdict Option B, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read HMRC-001 v1.0 in full, plus hatp_mandatory_cutover.py, hatp_bootstrap.py, and repository_identity.py source, plus 149O.1B.1's Class-B two-principal topology, to ground every design decision in existing, unmodified repository mechanism rather than invention. Reconstructed the exact hardcoded False ceiling (hatp_mandatory_cutover.py:842-853) and explained why it is a deliberate, correct fail-closed default, not a defect. Designed and froze exactly one selected architecture: authority principal = existing Class-B PCAE_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PRINCIPAL (same principal HMRC-REQ-041 already names as Protected Activation Authority); protected storage = existing HATPTrustStore.production().root (no new root); artifact topology = a protected registry-entry pair (certifications.json + certification-bindings.json) mirroring registry.json's own DeploymentBinding/SignerRecord shape, repository/deployment-keyed from the start (avoiding the Cutover Record's own flat single-slot limitation, explicitly not worsening it); implementation identity = git commit SHA plus a canonical digest over a frozen authority-bearing file set, recomputed fresh at every validation (no cache, mirroring HMRC-REQ-052 exactly), with the residual transitive-dependency limitation named explicitly as future-hardening work rather than hidden; explicit active-certification binding with no implicit-latest/glob/sort selection; a creation ceremony in which a separate, non-agent-writable admin tool -- never the ordinary pcae CLI, never an agent-reachable API -- computes every authority-sensitive field itself and the human only confirms a tool-derived target; CERTIFY and ACTIVATE kept as two separate, explicit ceremonies performed by the same principal (no circular trust); revocation and recertification designed to fail closed without ever causing HATP_MANDATORY to downgrade (monotonicity preserved, mirroring HMRC-REQ-039/040); concurrency via the same fcntl.flock discipline _write_cutover_transition already uses; local-only, unsigned certification (matching the Cutover Record's own unsigned-artifact trust boundary, explicitly rejecting cryptographic signature as ceremony theater absent a portability requirement). A full attack-matrix analysis (20 named attacks) covering repo/commit/report forgery, cross-repository replay, cross-deployment replay, cross-implementation replay (highest-priority property), cross-contract-version replay, deletion, corruption, unknown schema version, self-certification, alternate/env root override, symlink redirection, partial writes, protected-root absence, and TOCTOU across the activation lock, each rejected structurally rather than by policy prose alone. All five named stop conditions (no executable identity, no admin writer host, unsafe multi-repo topology, automatic downgrade on revocation, circular trust) evaluated explicitly and confirmed not triggered. Architecture verdict: SELECTED -- READY FOR CONTRACT FREEZE. Recommended next phase: 149O.19.2, HATP Mandatory Independent-Verification Certification Contract Freeze. Ran full Fast Green under the repository's own pinned CPython 3.9.6 (.venv): raw 5460 passed/28 failed/1 skipped (28 identical to 149O.19's own already-attributed pre-existing failures, confirmed unconditionally pre-existing since this phase made zero src/pcae/** changes), deselected 5460 passed/0 failed/1 skipped. No certification artifact was created. No Cutover Record or activation marker was created or modified. No real HATP_MANDATORY activation occurred. The hardcoded False readiness ceiling remains unchanged. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable.
